summary: Patterson-UTI Energy filed an 8-K regarding a $500M offering of 6.050% Senior Notes due 2036 via an underwriting agreement with Goldman Sachs, Wells Fargo, and Scotia Capital. Proceeds will redeem its 3.95% Senior Notes due 2028 (approx. $482.5M outstanding) plus general corporate purposes. The conditional redemption notice requires debt offering completion by June 4, 2026; close expected May 19, 2026. This is a refinancing transaction, not a return of capital to shareholders; thus categorized as Capital Returns with medium confidence as it primarily redeems existing debt.
